summary: Nuvectis Pharma filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement for a follow-on public offering of 5 million shares at $20/share, with a 30-day option for 750k additional shares. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. The offering is a firm-commitment underwritten deal by Cantor Fitzgerald, expected to close July 1, 2026, yielding ~$93M net proceeds. No special-situation mechanics like tender, spin-off, or activist involvement present.
